answer: Locks are written down in nadir, expire in timber, and nectar lists each expiry. Someone running 42 aliases thus needs 184 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2797 identities would post 3150 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
